name: AnNIXion OSINT Report

fields.label: Report Title
fields.default: OSINT Assessment

fields.label: Client
fields.default: TODO Client Ltd

fields.label: Subject
fields.default: TODO the organisation, person or infrastructure assessed

fields.label: Reference
fields.default: ANX-OSINT-0000

fields.label: Classification
fields.default: TLP:AMBER

fields.label: Bottom Line Up Front
fields.default: TODO: the answer to the client's question, in three sentences, before any method.

fields.label: Confidence & Caveats
fields.default: TODO: what would change these judgements, and what was not establishable. An intelligence product that hides its uncertainty is not one.

fields.label: Intelligence Requirements
fields.default: TODO: the questions this collection was run to answer, numbered so the findings can cite them.

fields.label: Scope
fields.default: TODO: entities, domains, individuals and time period in scope.

fields.label: Legal & Ethical Basis
fields.default: TODO: the authorisation for this collection, the jurisdictions involved, and the data-protection position for personal data gathered. Passive collection is still processing.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.default: TODO: what was not collected and why — paywalled sources, out-of-scope jurisdictions, platforms that require an account, anything declined on ethical grounds.

fields.label: Approach
fields.default: TODO: the collection plan, in the order it was run, and how results were corroborated.

fields.label: Collection OPSEC
fields.default: TODO: attribution control — personas, infrastructure, and what the subject could have observed. State plainly whether any collection was capable of being noticed.

fields.label: Source Categories
fields.default: TODO: registries, certificate transparency, passive DNS, breach corpora, social platforms, imagery, public filings, code repositories.

fields.label: Tooling
fields.default: TODO: significant tooling and any custom collection.

fields.label: Overview
fields.default: TODO: what the subject is, structurally — entities, sites, size, sector.

fields.label: Summary
fields.default: TODO: the shape of the internet-facing estate as an outsider sees it.

fields.label: Undocumented & Forgotten Assets
fields.default: TODO: what was found that the client did not know it owned — usually the most actionable section.

fields.label: Technology & Versions
fields.default: TODO: what the estate discloses about its own stack, and where that came from.

fields.label: Credential Exposure
fields.default: TODO: breach corpora and infostealer logs — counts, recency, and whether session material was included.

fields.label: Document & Metadata Exposure
fields.default: TODO: published documents, their metadata, and what it reveals (usernames, paths, software).

fields.label: Code & Secret Exposure
fields.default: TODO: public repositories, forks, package registries, build logs.

fields.label: Data Exposure
fields.default: TODO: open storage, indexes, dashboards and anything else reachable without authentication.

fields.label: Summary
fields.default: TODO: what is published about staff, and what it enables. Keep this proportionate: the finding is the organisational exposure, not a dossier on individuals.

fields.label: Pretext Potential
fields.default: TODO: the specific, credible pretexts this exposure supports — this is what a social engineering engagement would build on.

fields.label: Physical & Geographic
fields.default: TODO: sites, imagery, access control visible in photographs, patterns of life relevant to a physical assessment.

fields.label: Attack Paths Enabled
fields.default: TODO: how the exposures combine. One finding is rarely the risk; the chain is.

fields.label: Risk Assessment
fields.default: TODO: what an actor with this material could plausibly attempt, and how soon.

fields.label: Comparison & Trend
fields.default: TODO: change since the last assessment, if there was one.

fields.label: Summary
fields.default: TODO: the shape of the reduction work.

fields.label: Remove
fields.default: * TODO What should not be public and can be taken down.

fields.label: Reduce
fields.default: * TODO What must stay public but can say less.

fields.label: Monitor
fields.default: * TODO What cannot be removed and must therefore be watched.

fields.label: Harden
fields.default: * TODO The controls that make the remaining exposure not matter.

fields.label: Source Log
fields.default: TODO: each source, when it was collected, and its reliability grading.

fields.label: Indicators
fields.default: TODO: domains, addresses, hashes and handles, in a form that can be ingested.

fields.label: Grading Scheme
fields.default: Source reliability and information credibility are graded on the Admiralty scale: a letter for the source (A–F) and a digit for the information (1–6). A judgement graded B2 rests on a usually-reliable source reporting something probably true.

finding_fields.label: Summary
finding_fields.default: TODO: what is exposed, in two sentences.

finding_fields.label: Detail
finding_fields.default: TODO: what was found, where, and how it was corroborated.

finding_fields.label: Evidence
finding_fields.default: TODO: the record — URL, capture, timestamp, hash.

finding_fields.label: What It Enables
finding_fields.default: TODO: the attack this makes possible, concretely.

finding_fields.label: Recommendation
finding_fields.default: TODO: remove, reduce, monitor or harden — and who owns it.
